title: The Internet Is Losing It After Donald Trump Says He 'Examined' Senator Jon Husted's Body At Ohio Rally In Viral Clip: 'I Have Questions' - NewsBreak
text:
By Abigail Connolly ,
5 hours ago @Shutterstock.com/Matt Baron/BEI Donald Trump is going viral after making some unexpected comments about Senator Jon Husted’s appearance during a recent rally in Ohio.
The president took a detour from his political speech to discuss the Republican lawmaker’s physique, including his backside, leaving social media users stunned by how much attention he paid to another man’s body. Now, the bizarre moment has sparked plenty of reactions online, with some people joking that they have questions about Trump’s unhinged comments. Read more about what he said and how the internet reacted below.
Andrew Thomas/NurPhoto Donald Trump Goes On A Rant About Jon Husted's Body During An Ohio Rally Trump traveled to Youngstown, Ohio, on October 12th to rally support for Republican candidates ahead of the November midterm elections, including Jon Husted, who is facing a reelection challenge from former Democratic Senator Sherrod Brown.
During the event, the president praised Husted's political prospects and unexpectedly brought up the senator's athletic background at the University of Dayton, where he was an All-American defensive back. Trump then went into an unexpected description of how he examined Husted's body after learning about his football career, getting laughter from the crowd as he discussed the senator's backside, hands, and jawline.
"I don't do this with men very often," he stated. "I started examining his body because I didn't know he was a great athlete. And I looked, and I watched up and down. And I looked at his [behind]."
You can watch a video of Trump making his comments on Husted here .
@ Shutterstock.com/Bonnie Cash/UPI The Internet Reacts To Trump's Comments About Jon Husted's Appearance Clips of the 80-year-old 's remarks quickly made the rounds on social media, as viewers could hardly believe the president spent so much of his speech discussing the senator's physical appearance.
Some commenters even began speculating about Trump's interest in men, with one person joking about the timing of his remarks and another asking whether he was becoming more attracted to men as he got older.
"Trump is just bonkers," responded an X user.
"Imagine if you were at a conference or something and the featured speaker started eyeing you up and down and talking about you like this," wrote another.
"Trump is the ultimate definition of being two-faced," one user suggested, as another commented, "This is part of Trump's cognitive decline, where he has no filter anymore."
"Now we all know Trump has always said things that are just out there, but as his brain has gone more and more, the filter has completely gone," they continued.
"Someone tell Trump that National Coming Out Day was yesterday," a user joked.
"No normal president would ever say this," responded a user, with another adding, "I have questions."
